script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: "Chasing the Dream"

---

INT. COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

JASON (25, athletic, determined), with a latte in hand, scans the local newspaper. His face drops as he reads an article about his old high school basketball team's losing streak. He folds the paper and, feeling a sense of responsibility, gets up.

JASON
(looking around)
(whispering)
I can't let this be.

---

EXT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY

Jason arrives at the gym and enters the empty weight room. He spots an old friend, MIKE (25, muscular, charismatic), lifting weights. They exchange pleasantries, and Jason shares his concern about their alma mater's basketball team.

MIKE
That's a shame. But what can we do about it?

JASON
(determined)
We can do something. We can help them out.

Mike raises an eyebrow and smiles.

---

INT. COFFEE SHOP - EVENING

Jason and Mike sit in a cozy corner booth. They discuss plans to rebuild their high school basketball team. They reminisce about their past successes and the bond they shared on the court.

MIKE
I'd love to help, but I'm busy with work and my family. How about you lead the charge?

JASON
I will. But we need more than just the two of us. We need the whole community behind us.

---

EXT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - EVENING

Jason and Mike hold a community meeting. They invite parents, former players, and community members to join them in their quest to revitalize the team. The room fills up, and everyone shares their stories and memories of the basketball team.

---

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CLASSROOM - DAY

Jason stands in front of his class of motivated students, explaining his plans to rebuild the basketball team. Many students eagerly join, and they start practicing after school.

---

EXT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

Jason and the team practice late into the night, determined to overcome their losing streak. They struggle, but they never give up. Their passion and dedication shine through as they work together to improve.

---

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jason and Mike sit at their usual table, sipping their coffees and watching the rain outside. They discuss the team's progress and how far they've come.

MIKE
I'm proud of you, man. You've really pulled this off.

JASON
(smiling)
We couldn't have done it without you and the whole community.

---

EXT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

The team's first game against a rival school approaches. The gym is packed with supporters, and the tension is palpable. Jason and Mike lead the team onto the court, and they play with passion and determination.

---

EXT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

The final buzzer sounds, and the score is tied. The crowd roars as the teams prepare for overtime. The players exchange looks of determination, knowing that they've come too far to give up now.

---

EXT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

The game goes into double overtime. The team is tired, but their spirit remains unbroken. They give it their all, and in the final moments, they secure a stunning victory.

---

INT. COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

Jason and Mike sit in their usual booth, watching the sunrise. They reflect on their journey and the lessons they've learned.

MIKE
We did it, man. We chased the dream and made it a reality.

JASON
(smiling)
And we did it together.

They clink their coffees in a toast, their friendship stronger than ever.

---

THE END
